purpose: Content read from the player's own Marvel Rivals install by the launcher at Play and written under the DayZ folder (never shipped). Keywords pick candidate files; the discovery report lists what matched so the rows can be checked.

keywords.doc: All must appear (case-insensitive) in the Rivals file path.

output.doc: Path under the DayZ folder, without extension, as referenced from config and scripts.
